text: 钱去哪了？央行拆解存款结构：非银存款抬升，居民企业资金偏好定期 企业、机关团体、非银行业金融机构等定期存款比较多，也一定程度反映企业、居民的投资消费意愿。
text_en: Where has the money gone? PBOC breaks down deposit structure: non-bank deposits rise, households and firms prefer time deposits. Enterprises, government agencies and organizations, and non-bank financial institutions hold relatively more time deposits, which also reflects to some extent firms' and households' willingness to invest and consume.
